hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true

cat >/dev/null; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/rules/cavecrew-rules.md"; cat >/dev/null; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -n --rawfile c "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SubagentStart",additionalContext:$c}}'; exit 0
if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then graphify hook-guard search; fi
if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then graphify hook-guard read; fi
s="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh"; bash -n "$s" 2>/dev/null || { echo "protect-files: script missing or does not parse, guard disabled" >&2; exit 0; }; exec bash "$s"
